titleText: Black Friday shoppers hunt for bargains without the rush
mainText: From Times of Malta: Black Friday shoppers hunt for bargains without the rush. Christmas shopping and festive outfits among the priorities for shoppers making the most of seasonal discounts

titleText: Watch: Police investigating altercation at Sports Direct outlet in Qormi
mainText: From Times of Malta: Watch: Police investigating altercation at Sports Direct outlet in Qormi. Incident caught on camera was unrelated to Black Friday shopping frenzy

titleText: Paola to get 10 new social housing apartments through €903,000 investment
mainText: From The Malta Independent: Paola to get 10 new social housing apartments through €903,000 investment. Two social housing projects in Paola are expected to deliver 10 new apartments by 2027, with a combined investment of around €903,000, a government statement said.

titleText: 'No one should be forgotten' - Caritas' Christmas lunch to be held again
mainText: From The Malta Independent: 'No one should be forgotten' - Caritas' Christmas lunch to be held again. This year, Caritas Malta's Christmas Lunch initiative will be held at the Archbishop's Curia in Floriana.

titleText: Contractor delays held up Triq tal-Qares repaving after works, Enemalta says
mainText: From MaltaToday: Contractor delays held up Triq tal-Qares repaving after works, Enemalta says. Reinstatement works on a section of Triq tal-Qares in Mosta are expected to begin in the coming days, Enemalta has said, following delays by the private contractor engaged to carry them out.
